lines.en: Ana, you will not believe this. By the time the big firm called, I had already accepted another offer.
lines.pt: Ana, você não vai acreditar. Quando a grande empresa ligou, eu já tinha aceitado outra proposta.

lines.en: Really? I thought you had been waiting for that call for weeks. Had they told you a date?
lines.pt: Sério? Achei que você esperava essa ligação havia semanas. Eles tinham dito uma data?

lines.en: They had promised an answer by Friday, but by Monday nobody had written to me, so I had lost patience.
lines.pt: Eles tinham prometido uma resposta até sexta, mas na segunda ninguém tinha me escrito, então eu tinha perdido a paciência.

lines.en: And the other company? Had you met the team before you signed the contract?
lines.pt: E a outra empresa? Você tinha conhecido a equipe antes de assinar o contrato?

lines.en: Yes, I had visited the office twice, and the manager had explained the onboarding programme in detail.
lines.pt: Sim, eu tinha visitado o escritório duas vezes, e o gerente tinha explicado o programa de integração em detalhes.

lines.en: Then it was a sensible decision. When you resigned, had you already told your boss about your plans?
lines.pt: Então foi uma decisão sensata. Quando você pediu demissão, já tinha contado seus planos ao seu chefe?

lines.en: Not exactly. I had hinted that I was unhappy, but he hadn’t imagined I would leave, so he was shocked.
lines.pt: Não exatamente. Eu tinha insinuado que estava insatisfeita, mas ele não imaginava que eu sairia, então ficou chocado.

lines.en: Did he make a counteroffer? Before I left my last job, they had offered me a raise, but it was too late.
lines.pt: Ele fez uma contraproposta? Antes de eu sair do meu último emprego, tinham me oferecido um aumento, mas era tarde demais.

lines.en: He did, after I had signed. It was a funny moment, because I had spent a month thinking about this move.
lines.pt: Fez, depois de eu ter assinado. Foi um momento engraçado, porque eu tinha passado um mês pensando nessa mudança.

lines.en: So when does the new job start? Have you finished your notice period?
lines.pt: Então quando começa o novo emprego? Você já terminou o aviso prévio?

lines.en: Next month. After I had handed in my notice, I realised that I had never felt so free in my career.
lines.pt: No mês que vem. Depois de entregar o aviso, percebi que nunca tinha me sentido tão livre na carreira.

items.wrong: When they called, I accepted already another offer.
items.fix: When they called, I had already accepted another offer.
items.why: For an action before a past moment, use had + participle.

items.wrong: I had went to the office twice.
items.fix: I had been to the office twice.
items.why: The participle of go is gone/been, not went.

items.wrong: Did you had met the team?
items.why: Make the question with Had + subject + participle.

Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.

facts.label: Past perfect
facts.sub: O fato anterior: By the time they called, I had accepted another offer. Pergunta: Had you…? Negativa: hadn’t. O fato posterior fica no simple past.

facts.label: Ordem na história
facts.sub: O past perfect aparece junto com o simple past: When she arrived, he had left. O mais antigo vai no past perfect; o mais recente, no simple past. Ajuda a organizar histórias.

facts.label: already, before, by the time
facts.sub: Marcadores comuns: already, never, before, after, by the time, when. Eles mostram a ordem dos fatos. Exemplo: After I had signed, I felt relieved. Nem sempre são obrigatórios.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Had + past participle shows the earlier past action.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: We use the past perfect for actions happening now.
items.why: It is for something before a past moment.

items.s: By the time is often followed by the simple past.
items.why: Yes.

answers: Had + past participle shows the earlier past action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use the past perfect for actions happening now. → Falso (It is for something before a past moment.)
By the time is often followed by the simple past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: The call that came too late · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy afternoon in downtown Chicago. Edith waits for Ana in a small café. She has important news about her career. Two companies wanted her at the same time. One of them was slower than the other. Now the whole story can finally be told.

“Ana, you will not believe this. By the time the big firm called, I had already accepted another offer.” says Edith. “Really? I thought you had been waiting for that call for weeks. Had they told you a date?” says Ana. “They had promised an answer by Friday, but by Monday nobody had written to me, so I had lost patience.” says Edith.
